_comment: EP04 承接 EP03（Vance Capital 收购 Sterling，Claire 即 'V' 完成清算开局）。沿用全部既有角色与场景资产，不换脸、不换服装。每镜 2 人脸 + 1 场景/道具板，规避 Flow 三人脸政策过滤。台词自然闭嘴在 3.9s / 9.3s 前，方便卡 scdet 硬切点。

1.name: ep04_seq01_audit_begins
1.prompt:
Controlled cold corporate reckoning in the dark walnut chandelier ballroom converted to a boardroom at dawn. Real-time 24fps motion, hard cuts only, strictly NO wine glasses anywhere, strictly NO BGM, strictly NO on-screen subtitles. Pale morning window light mixing with warm chandelier glow sculpting real skin pores and polished walnut texture, authentic Kodak film grain.

Active References Lock:
- Reference 1: Claire, adult 24-year-old woman, FULLY DRY and immaculate, ivory belted trench coat over grey silk slip dress, hair neat and dry (100% match face, hair, and outfit to Reference 1 char_claire.jpg — NO wet stains, NO wet hair).
- Reference 2: Damien, adult 32-year-old man in midnight-black cashmere overcoat over matte black dress shirt (100% match Reference 2).
- Reference 3: Opulent dark walnut chandelier gala ballroom (100% match Reference 3).

[0.0s - 4.2s] SHOT A - 29 degree MEDIUM FRONT TRACKING INTO THE BALLOOM BOARDROOM:
First visible frame shows Claire striding calmly to the head of the walnut table, fully dry and composed, Damien following half a pace behind in his black cashmere overcoat. Claire speaks in a cool level register finishing before 3.9s with mouth closing cleanly: "Good morning, gentlemen. The audit of Sterling begins now."

[4.2s - 10.0s] HARD CUT TO SHOT B - 18 degree TIGHT CLOSE-UP ON CLAIRE:
Claire halts, lifts her eyes with flat absolute authority, no smile. She commands crisply finishing before 9.3s with mouth closed: "Every dollar that left this house in ninety nights—I will trace it."

Active References Lock:

- Reference 2: Chloe, adult 24-year-old woman in deep crimson satin high-neck gown, humiliated and angry (100% match face and dress to Reference 2).
- Reference 3: Opulent dark walnut chandelier gala ballroom (100% match Reference 3).

[0.0s - 4.2s] SHOT A - 29 degree MEDIUM TWO-SHOT IN SHADOW:
Marcus leans toward Chloe, jaw tight, eyes hard with resentment. He snarls quietly finishing before 3.9s with mouth closing: "She thinks that crimson seal ended it. It barely started."

[4.2s - 10.0s] HARD CUT TO SHOT B - 18 degree TIGHT PROFILE ON MARCUS:
Marcus straightens, cold determination replacing panic. He states finishing before 9.3s with mouth closing cleanly: "By dawn, this board will beg me to take her place."

3.name: ep04_seq03_forged_papers

- Reference 2: Exact open navy leather portfolio showing the ivory SKYLINE TOWER architectural elevation line drawing AND the fixed embossed crimson-gold V wax seal in the lower-right corner (100% match Reference 2, zero wine glass).

Marcus looks up with a hard, threatening edge. He states finishing before 9.3s with mouth closing cleanly: "I'll put her in handcuffs before she puts me in a grave."

Claire strides steadily forward down the bright checkered marble foyer with calm upright posture, Damien following respectfully half a step behind. Claire states quietly finishing before 3.9s: "Vance Capital now holds every creditor in this city."

[4.2s - 10.0s] HARD CUT TO SHOT B - 18 degree SIDE-PROFILE CLOSE-UP OF CLAIRE:
Cool dawn daylight catches her dry hair and composed profile. Without turning back, with natural restraint, she states finishing before 9.3s with mouth closing cleanly: "This was not a takeover. This was a reckoning." She continues striding toward the bright glass exit doors.
